BarbourSmith/RotatePattern: Circular pattern. Makes Number copies of Shape, each rotated a further Angle degrees about the Z axis through the origin. For N copies evenly around a full circle use Number = N and Angle = 360 / N. Move the shape off the origin first to set the pattern radius.
alzatin/Linear-Pattern: Linear pattern. Makes Number copies of Geometry; copy i is moved by i times (distX, distY, distZ).
BarbourSmith/Center_XY: Moves a shape so its bounding box is centered on the origin in X and Y.
BarbourSmith/Width: Measures a shape: returns its width as a number, for driving other parameters.
